fieldValues.title: Should continuity be a separate update, or part of each minutes stage?
fieldValues.thinking_reached: Raised by the second-meeting pass (Research: Protocol evolution, part 6). No option chosen.
fieldValues.tensions:
Options, none chosen:
- A. A separate update protocol after the minutes, as tested: additive, and it can be re-run when subjects are re-filed.
- B. Every minutes stage reads the series: a decision point continues an earlier one and a task updates an earlier task as they are written.
- C. Both: stages link as they go, and the update accounts for what nothing linked to.
fieldValues.unresolved_questions: Whether B makes minutes better or just longer briefs; whether a decision point that continues an earlier one is the same record, a successor, or a new one with a relation.
fieldValues.next_action: Run option B on the November meeting and compare the minutes and the follow-ups.
